bootstrap.scheme: analyze_dev.Boot (W63): per-block statistic, block bootstrap / t over block means (t when < 10 blocks), crossed task x block secondary

coding: primary: KV reference = kv16r (Q/K rotation on, no KV quant). Named contrasts are paired unit-level differences (e.g. I_AK|W16 = Y_A4K4 - Y_A4K16r - Y_A16K4 + Y_A16K16r), each on the units with all its cells. averaged_effects: s = +1 at 4 bits, -1 at 16 bits, effect = (1/4) sum s Y over the 8 cells. legacy_confounded: the same with kv16 (rotation off), reported only for the record.
scope: effects among these QuaRot-rotated 4-bit axes on q4; not a statement about other formats (RTN-W3 alone is heavily damaging)
